completed_changes: Phases 1-8 compatibility, deployment, blacklist, trace, admin paging, statistics and card-generation work remain intact
Phase 8 real deployment/admin behavior was user-reported successful
Production legacy-controller access-log audit was completed by the user
Phase 9 formally removed App-mb.php and Index2.php from the development branch and CI now requires them to remain absent
Phase 9 closure CI passed on PHP 7.0, 8.2 and 8.4
Phase 10A centralizes external source HTTP POST behavior with connect/total timeouts, error logging and TLS peer/host verification enabled by default
Phase 10A provides SOURCE_HTTP_VERIFY_TLS=0 only as an emergency compatibility rollback and keeps the existing nuosike endpoints/protocol
Phase 10B introduces SourceAppRecord semantic aliases for legacy fa_category columns without renaming or migrating the database
Phase 10B routes AppStorePayload and public-source field selection through semantic names while preserving the old public schema
Phase 10C centralizes plain and encrypted source body encoding in SourceResponse while deliberately preserving legacy body/header behavior
Card activation now stacks each newly used card after the furthest active expiration for the same UDID; each individual card remains one-time use
Public /unbind page supports self-service device replacement using a previously bound card plus old/new UDID
Device transfer requires an active old-device entitlement, rejects active blacklist states and an already-active new device, and moves the activated-card history to the new UDID

performance_findings.conclusion: The external whole-payload encryption service remains the dominant encrypted /appstore latency. Phase 10 adds bounded timeouts/TLS handling but does not change the appstore/appstore_v2 protocol or provider.

compatibility_boundaries: No physical fa_category schema rename/migration is performed
Each card code is still one-time activation even though authorization time can stack without limit
Existing appstore/appstore_v2 response keys and encryption endpoints are unchanged
Strict TLS is now the default; SOURCE_HTTP_VERIFY_TLS=0 is an emergency rollback only until live provider TLS is verified
next_task: Deploy Phase 10 to a staging/live-compatible site and smoke-test plain/encrypted appstore, strict TLS to both encryption endpoints, two or more stacked card activations, and /unbind old-to-new device transfer before promoting Phase 10 as the next stable production baseline.
